verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an official, documented xAI developer API with a quickstart, rich capability docs (streaming, structured outputs, reasoning, image and video), and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, so developers can build against an official interface. However, no evidence item names or documents an official language SDK. missing for 10: an explicitly documented official SDK (named packages and supported languages), SDK installation and usage docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
